title: CSV line splitter that keeps empty edge fields
requirements: split_line(line) splits a CSV line on commas and returns the fields as strings
Double-quoted fields may contain commas and '""' inside quotes is a literal quote; an unterminated quote raises ValueError
Empty fields are kept, including leading and trailing ones: split_line(',a,') == ['', 'a', '']
(after the user switch) join_line(fields) is the inverse, quoting only fields that contain a comma or a quote
user_messages: csvline.split_line(line) for the importer — split on commas, fields come back as strings
quoted fields can have commas inside, and "" inside quotes is a literal quote. an unclosed quote should raise ValueError
empty fields have to survive, INCLUDING at the start and end: ',a,' → ['', 'a', ''] — we lost a column last time because of a trailing comma
and a join_line(fields) that goes the other way — only quote a field when it has a comma or a quote in it
